name: SF2 v-next.4 - Discovery Maps + Tavily Web + Manual Import + Cache

parameters.content: SF2 v-next.4 - Discovery with THREE engines (F27 + Tavily web). v-next.4 (Wonder DO-NOT-PROMOTE fixes on v-next.3): (1) the Tavily branch now uses the SAME F29 discovery cache as the Apify branch (key material prefixed 'tavily|', 24h TTL default; a hit returns the cached candidates with a cache_hit_zero ledger row - a WF00 rerun with a new run_id no longer re-spends within the TTL); (2) the same-run guard is now an ATOMIC claim (one CTE insert ... on conflict do nothing returning, claimed boolean) taken after a cache miss and before any search - losing the claim returns already_discovered WITH the count of companies already saved for that run_id (existing_companies), never a silent zero; (3) the listicle filter is DYNAMIC: a best/top title is skipped only when it also contains a keyword from that result's OWN search query (location tokens and stopwords excluded, singular/plural tolerant) - no hardcoded category list anywhere. Engine gate: discovery_source='tavily' routes to the Tavily branch (profile-driven: apify_maps queries become web searches, tavily_research queries used as-is; candidates in the SAME contract with source='tavily_web', no place_id/rating/phone; per-run Tavily spend ledgered once, idempotent; Tavily results are cached in discovery_cache under a 'tavily|' key prefix with the run's TTL). Default/'places' keeps the original Apify path with its F29 cache, byte-identical to v-next.1. Places path = the original SF2 (profile-driven Apify Google Places). Manual-import path: reads an import Sheet with exact headers company_name, domain, location, source_url; a missing header halts the branch with a Gmail draft naming the header; rows are normalised (domain lowercased, www./scheme stripped, location trimmed) and emitted in the SAME candidate contract with source='manual_import' + source_url, merging into the same Collect return so SF4 dedupe handles both paths identically. Input adds discovery_source ('places' default | 'manual_import'), import_sheet_id, import_tab.

parameters.query: SELECT profile FROM search_profiles WHERE id = $1::uuid

SELECT c.result_company_ids AS candidates, c.discovered_count AS count, true AS hit
FROM discovery_cache c
WHERE c.cache_key = encode(sha256($1::bytea), 'hex') AND c.expires_at > now()
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, false
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM discovery_cache c WHERE c.cache_key = encode(sha256($1::bytea), 'hex') AND c.expires_at > now())

INSERT INTO cost_ledger (run_id, workflow, provider, event_type, units, cost_usd, company_id, idempotency_key)
VALUES ($1, 'SF2 v-next.4', 'tavily', 'cache_hit_zero', 0, 0, NULL, 'sf2:tavily:cachehit:' || $1 || ':' || $2)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO cost_ledger (run_id, workflow, provider, event_type, units, cost_usd, company_id, idempotency_key)
  SELECT $1, 'SF2 v-next.4', 'tavily', 'estimate', 0, 0, NULL, 'sf2:tavily:guard:' || $1
  WHERE $1 IS NOT NULL AND $1 <> ''
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)) AS claimed

} };
